timing_quality_gate.stage_steady_dispersion: Each of all 36 stage records has 64 steady raw QPC ticks. Linear-interpolated P90/P10 must be <= 1.5; a nonpositive P10 is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.cross_process_medians: For every (V, pattern, stage) group, exactly three process steady medians are required. max(abs(process_median - median_of_process_medians))/median_of_process_medians must be <= 0.05; a nonpositive/nonfinite denominator is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.observer_overhead: For every stage, median of its process 64 empty-QPC-bracket ticks divided by its steady median must be <= 0.01. Empty brackets are recorded only and never subtracted; zero/nonfinite steady denominators are diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.frequency: All three before/after fields os_max_mhz, os_reported_current_mhz and os_limit_mhz must be positive and equal. Unavailable (zero) is not stable; any difference is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.denominators: 3 processes x 6 cases = 18 case-process records; 3 x 6 x 2 = 36 stage records; 6 x 2 = 12 cross-process case/stage groups.
timing_quality_gate.acceptance: Any failed timing-quality gate preserves raw results but requires timing_usable=false, diagnostic_only=true and accepted_for_timing_evidence=false. No timing extrapolation, coefficient fitting or observer subtraction is allowed.
